name: tracker-outbox-receipts
goal: Keep only the newest 20 acknowledged phone Tracker writes after an offline queue drains.

evidence: Acknowledgments can arrive after all queued writes are inserted. Trimming at enqueue never runs as that batch drains, so the inbox retains more than 20 acknowledged writes.
The existing native outbox fixture checked durable ordering and conflict discard but accepted only one receipt. It now queues 21 writes before acknowledging them and checks the exact 20 retained IDs.
Native clean-snapshot checkpoint faf8ef5c6978 failed the receipt retention assertion in both Debug and Release.
Trim acknowledged receipts in the transaction that records acceptance. Keep pending and conflict rows outside the retention rule.
Unchanged native check passed on f3a20cd448 in the same environment. Checkpoint 99b38b0fc1b7, Debug 358/358 and Release 336/336.
